name: Yoga school in Stockholm
reason: No usable school found in three searches. The best candidate, Skandinavisk Yoga och Meditationsskola (yoga.se, classical/Satyananda-based, the city's oldest school), has a robots.txt group naming ClaudeBot, Claude-Web and anthropic-ai with Disallow: /, so the site is off limits (owner, 5 Nov 2026). Other results were directories (BookRetreats, Yoga Alliance Professionals, Reco, Yogobe event listings) or past trainings (Urban OM 2018/19, Embodied Yin at Pranama 2020/21) with no own site found.
